title: 第一卷 第99章 又见御尸术第一卷 第98章 大战结束
slug: 乱世加点从猎户到武圣只杀不赦
content_zh:
“将军，属下回来了。”
李毅掀开帐门，径直走进了中军大营内，只见关将军正坐在案桌前处理着军务。
闻言，关将军抬眸一看，顿时一喜，起身向前一迎，拉着李毅的手说道：
“好啊好啊，你果然没有让我失望。”
李毅这一次率军出击，不仅将进攻秋风关的一万青国大军全歼，还深入青国境内，攻破宣城等数座重城，击杀青国守军数万，更是将青国的辎重焚烧一空。
受此影响，青国攻势减缓，局势转向了陈国这一边，若不是有着黑风门修士与匈奴的协助，青国早就被关将军带兵清剿一空。
寒暄几句后，关将军便拉着李毅来到了营帐前，指着沙盘对着李毅说道：
“按照斥候回报，如今两万匈奴大军已经与青国合兵一处，共计有七万大军。
除此之外，还有数千妖兽大军，而我雁门关内则有着九万大军。”
顿了顿，关将军说道：
“不过，虽然我军兵力占优，但青国有着大量的骑兵以及妖兽相助，一时间，我们只能陷入僵持。”
李毅看着沙盘上的数据，不断思索着：
“将军请放心，有我麾下精锐，这局面很快便能打开了。”
李毅顿了顿，便将自己的诸多想法和盘托出。
而营帐内的其余军官也围在一旁，听着李毅的话。
时至今日，李毅已经以自己的战绩折服了雁门关地区的任何人，对于李毅所言，他们皆是极为信服。
“好，就按你说的办。”
关将军点了点头，随即便派出宋杰带领重骑兵营，随李毅一道出战。
一时间，雁门关地区再次陷入了激战之中。
经过数日的试探性交手，青陈两方折损不少，更是在一些地区打出了真火。

一夜，李毅回到了营帐中处理着军务，却见木钱子与木星子一道走进了帐篷内。
李毅抬眸一看，望向这两位青云宗弟子开口道：
“两位师兄，不知深夜来我这营帐中，可有何事？”
木星子从怀中取出一封书信递给了李毅，缓缓道：
“宗内听闻妖兽组成了妖兽联盟，又有匈奴萨满参与，便再次派出了一支弟子前来支援你。”
“哦？”
李毅闻言一喜，连忙接过密信翻看起来。
青云宗掌门木阳子这一次派来支援的青云宗弟子有三百人，这三百人中有近半都是真气境弟子，剩下的一百多炼体境弟子，实力也极强，最低也是炼体六重的修为。
而这一支援军的领头者，则是李毅的师兄，罡气境的木战子。
“好，有了宗门的支援，这妖兽联盟与匈奴萨满等便不足为惧了。”
李毅点了点头，便将书信放在一侧，与木星子等人商讨着援军到来之后的安置计划。
数日后，李毅骑着赤兔马，北出雁门关直扑青国大营。
经过这多日的试探，双方都皆已明白，已经到了决战之时。
随着李毅前冲，风虎营、破虏营五千精锐紧随其后，向着青国大本营冲去。
虽然在北上青国境内一战中，折损了一千左右的精锐士卒，但在回到雁门关后，李毅快速提拔预备营中的精锐士卒补充了风虎营、破虏营的编制。
而在李毅的精心培养与诸多赏赐下，这一支大军，修为最低者都有炼体四重的修为，同时，这也是雁门关九万陈国大军中，唯一一支全员都是武者的精锐部队。
要知道，就连关将军麾下的关字营也无法做到每一个士卒都有着炼体四重的修为。
随着李毅带兵出击，宋杰也带着麾下的重骑兵营宛如一把尖刀般，直指青国大军。
面对陈国凌厉攻势，青国主将姚丁元毫无惧意，坐镇中军，发出一道道命令，驱使着麾下应敌。
只见一队队青国士卒自大营中涌出，在雁门关外的空地上结成阵势，迎接着陈国大军的到来。

而在其身侧，一队队匈奴骑兵正挥舞着弯刀，掩护着青国大军。
与此同时，不远处的山林中，正有着一只只妖兽从其内钻出，在妖王的带领下，汇集为一支异兽大军，虎视眈眈地望着雁门关。
content_en:
"General, my subordinate is back."
Li Yi opened the tent door and walked straight into the Chinese army camp. He saw General Guan sitting at the desk handling military affairs.
Hearing this, General Guan looked up and was immediately delighted. He stood up and stepped forward to greet him. He took Li Yi's hand and said:
"Okay, okay, you really didn't disappoint me."
Li Yi led his army to attack this time. Not only did he annihilate all the 10,000 Qing Kingdom troops who attacked Qiufeng Pass, he also penetrated deep into Qing Kingdom, broke through several important cities such as Xuancheng, killed tens of thousands of Qing Kingdom defenders, and even burned all the Qing Kingdom's baggage.
Affected by this, Qingguo's offensive slowed down, and the situation turned to Chen Guo's side. If it were not for the assistance of the Black Wind Sect monks and the Huns, Qingguo would have been wiped out by General Guan's troops.
After a few words of greeting, General Guan took Li Yi to the camp, pointed to the sand table and said to Li Yi:
"According to the scouts' reports, 20,000 Xiongnu troops have joined forces with the Qing Kingdom, with a total of 70,000 troops.
In addition, there are thousands of demonic beast armies, and I have an army of 90,000 in Yanmen Pass. "
After a pause, General Guan said:
"However, although our army has the upper hand, Qing Kingdom has a large number of cavalry and monster beasts to help. For a while, we can only fall into a stalemate."
Li Yi looked at the data on the sand table and kept thinking:
"General, please rest assured. With my elite men, this situation will be resolved soon."
Li Yi paused and told all his thoughts.
The other officers in the camp also gathered around, listening to Li Yi's words.
To this day, Li Yi has convinced everyone in the Yanmenguan area with his achievements. They are all extremely convinced of what Li Yi said.
"Okay, I'll do as you say."
General Guan nodded, and then sent Song Jie to lead the heavy cavalry battalion to fight with Li Yi.
For a time, the Yanmenguan area fell into fierce fighting again.
After several days of tentative fighting, Qing and Chen suffered a lot of losses, and even started to fight in some areas.
One night, Li Yi returned to the camp to handle military affairs, but saw Mu Qianzi and Jupiter Zi walking into the tent together.
Li Yi raised his eyes, looked at the two Qingyun Sect disciples and said:
"Two senior brothers, why do you want to come to my tent late at night?"
Jupiter took out a letter from his arms and handed it to Li Yi, saying slowly:
"The sect heard that the monster beasts formed a monster beast alliance and that the Xiongnu shaman participated, so they sent another group of disciples to support you."
"Oh?"
Li Yi was delighted when he heard this and quickly took the secret letter and read it.
Mu Yangzi, the head of Qingyun Sect, sent 300 Qingyun Sect disciples to support this time. Nearly half of these 300 people were Zhenqi Realm disciples. The remaining more than 100 Body Refining Realm disciples were also very strong, with the lowest cultivation level of the sixth level of Body Refining.
The leader of this supporting army is Li Yi's senior brother, Mu Zhanzi of the Gang Qi Realm.
"Okay, with the support of the sect, there is nothing to fear from the monster alliance and the Hun shaman."
Li Yi nodded, put the letter aside, and discussed with Jupiter and others the resettlement plan after the reinforcements arrived.
A few days later, Li Yi rode a red rabbit horse and went north from Yanmen Pass to attack the Qingguo camp.
After many days of testing, both sides have understood that it is time for a decisive battle.
As Li Yi rushed forward, five thousand elites from Fenghu Camp and Polu Camp followed closely, rushing towards the Qingguo base camp.
Although he lost about a thousand elite soldiers in the battle in Qingguo in the north, after returning to Yanmen Pass, Li Yi quickly promoted the elite soldiers in the reserve camp to supplement the establishment of Fenghu Camp and Polu Camp.
Thanks to Li Yi's careful training and many rewards, the lowest cultivation level of this army has reached the fourth level of body refining. At the same time, this is also the only elite army among the 90,000 Chen State army in Yanmen Pass where all members are warriors.
You know, even the Guanzi Battalion under General Guan cannot ensure that every soldier has aThe cultivation level of the fourth level of body refining.
As Li Yi led his troops to attack, Song Jie also led his heavy cavalry battalion like a sharp knife, pointing directly at the Qing Kingdom army.
Facing Chen Guo's fierce offensive, Qing Guo's commander-in-chief Yao Dingyuan showed no fear. He took command of the central army and issued orders one after another, driving his men to respond to the enemy.
I saw groups of Qing soldiers pouring out of the camp and forming a formation in the open space outside Yanmen Pass to welcome the arrival of the Chen army.
Beside him, groups of Hun cavalry were waving scimitars, covering the Qing army.
At the same time, in the mountain forest not far away, monster beasts were emerging from it. Under the leadership of the monster king, they gathered into an army of strange beasts, looking at Yanmen Pass with eager eyes.
